title: The Aeroplane, 19 Mar 1948, p.339: zero-lift drag vs thickness graph (Fig. 23)
description: Magazine page with a graph captioned "Fig. 23.—Increase of zero lift profile drag with thickness ratio of symmetrical aerofoil sections" showing curves and small section sketches for flat plate and other profiles (data from Gerber, Zurich Report No. 6). A small table lists angles of sweep-back against required aspect ratio, from M. B. Morgan. Text discusses German flying wing development and "Hitler's Last Secret Weapon"; ends "(To be continued.)".
